cases.prompt: How many students are enrolled at Sunrise Shiksha for 2025-26?
cases.expect: A single count matching the Enrolment sheet row count (the 2-row merged group header above the real column headers must not be counted as a data row).

cases.prompt: Which students dropped out between the baseline and endline assessment?
cases.expect: Students present in the Baseline table but absent from the Endline table below it. The two blocks share no ID scheme (Roll No vs none) so a correct answer must join on student name, not ID. Total dropouts: 28.

cases.prompt: Which indicators are behind target in the Q1 funder report?
cases.expect: Rows where Achieved < Target, excluding the bottom TOTAL row. Top rows ranked by shortfall (Target - Achieved), descending.

cases.prompt: What was total student attendance (days present) across all classes in June 2025?
cases.expect: Sum of the 'Jun-25' column in the wide-by-month Attendance sheet (Attendance ID differs from the Enrolment sheet's Student ID; join by name/class if the tool needs to combine the two sheets).

cases.prompt: How many SHGs are registered in Manchar village?
cases.expect: Count of shg_master.csv rows where village equals the named village.

cases.prompt: Which SHGs have the highest outstanding loan balance as of September?
cases.expect: Top rows of loan_ledger.xlsx ranked by 'Outstanding Balance' descending (the sheet is wide-by-month; balance is the last column).

cases.prompt: Which invoices are overdue and still have a balance pending?
cases.expect: Rows with Status == 'Overdue' from the Zoho Books export, ranked by parsed Balance (the column is a currency string like '₹12,500.00', not a number) descending.

cases.prompt: How many women completed at least their first ANC visit (ANC1)?
cases.expect: Count of rows where visit/anc1 == 'yes' in the KoboToolbox export.

cases.prompt: Which health camps had the most women attendees?
cases.expect: camp_register.xlsx has one title-row + attendee-table block per camp (not one tidy table); a correct answer aggregates women count per camp from those blocks and ranks descending.

cases.prompt: How many beneficiaries have received an assistive device?
cases.expect: Count of rows where Assistive Device Issued is non-empty. Dates in this sheet are mixed dd/mm/yyyy and yyyy-mm-dd; a correct tool should not mis-parse or drop rows because of that.

cases.prompt: Which device type has the lowest stock remaining?
cases.expect: The running 'balance_after' column is a stock ledger, not a stock table; a correct answer takes the most recent (by date) balance per device_type and ranks ascending.

cases.prompt: How many leads in the donor CRM export are marked 'Converted'?
cases.expect: Count of rows where Lead Status == 'Converted' in the Zoho CRM export.

cases.prompt: What was the total captured amount raised for the WinterDrive2025 campaign?
cases.expect: Sum of 'amount' (paise, divide by 100 for INR) where status == 'captured' and notes.campaign matches, in razorpay_payments.csv.

cases.prompt: Which donors made more than one captured payment (i.e. gave twice or more)?
cases.expect: Group captured rows in razorpay_payments.csv by email/contact; donors with count > 1, ranked by count descending.

cases.prompt: How many 80G receipts were issued in total for 2025?
cases.expect: Row count of 80g_receipts_2025.xlsx (one receipt per captured donation sampled for receipting).

cases.prompt: Which expense heads are over their FY25-26 budget based on Apr-Sep actuals?
cases.expect: Rows of the pre-pivoted 'Budget vs Actual' sheet where Actual > Budget (variance > 0), ranked by variance descending.

cases.prompt: Which staff members had the most absent (A) days in August?
cases.expect: From the wide days-1..31 attendance grid, count 'A' codes per row and rank descending (the sheet already includes a pre-summed 'A' column that should agree with a fresh count of the day columns).

cases.prompt: What was the total distance travelled by the fleet in June 2025?
cases.expect: Sum of km_travelled in vehicle_log.csv for trips dated in June 2025 (dates are dd/mm/yyyy strings).

cases.prompt: From the WhatsApp field group chat, which days had the highest reported number of children attending, and how many?
cases.expect: The chat is a raw 'dd/mm/yy, HH:MM - Name: message' export with ordinary chatter, <Media omitted> lines and shared phone numbers mixed in; a correct answer extracts only the daily count messages (e.g. 'Aaj <village> mein N bacche aaye') and ranks by N descending.

cases.prompt: Which villages received the most field visits?
cases.expect: Count of rows per village in village_visit_log.csv, ranked descending.

cases.prompt: How many households were reached in June 2025 across all villages?
cases.expect: Sum of the households column in the June sheet. The column header text drifts across the workbook's month sheets ('No. of HH' in April/May, 'Households reached' in June/July/September, 'HH Covered' in August) even though it is the same indicator; a correct tool must reconcile that before summing, not treat them as different metrics.

cases.prompt: Which villages had the highest total households reached across Apr-Sep 2025?
cases.expect: Top rows of the Consolidated sheet (values pasted from formulas, not live formulas) ranked by Total HH Reached descending.

cases.prompt: Build a funder-facing dashboard for Sunrise Shiksha summarising Q1 enrolment, attendance trend and learning assessment progress.
cases.expect: Must reconcile the three ID schemes across Enrolment/Attendance/Assessment sheets (join by name), show a monthly attendance trend from the wide Attendance sheet, report the dropout count from ask-02, and reflect the Indicator Tracker's target vs achieved without double-counting the TOTAL row.

cases.prompt: Build a loan portfolio dashboard by village showing amount disbursed, outstanding balance, and overdue invoice exposure per SHG.
cases.expect: Must join shg_master.csv to loan_ledger.xlsx by SHG ID, compute outstanding balance from the wide monthly repayment columns (not just read the label), and separately surface overdue/unpaid Zoho invoices with currency strings parsed to numbers.

cases.prompt: Build a monthly maternal-health dashboard: ANC visit funnel (ANC1 through ANC4 drop-off) from the Kobo export, plus camp attendance by village and gender from the camp register.
cases.expect: Must compute the ANC1->ANC4 funnel drop-off correctly (each stage is only valid if the prior stage is 'yes'), and must aggregate the camp register's repeated title+table blocks per camp into one row per camp rather than treating title rows as data.

cases.prompt: Build a device inventory and beneficiary support dashboard: current stock per device type, beneficiaries served, and device coverage by disability type.
cases.expect: Must derive current stock from the IN/OUT device_inventory.csv ledger (last balance per device, not a sum of all rows), and must not break on the mixed dd/mm/yyyy vs yyyy-mm-dd dates in beneficiary_master.xlsx.

cases.prompt: Build a donor funnel dashboard: CRM lead status breakdown (New -> Contacted -> Qualified -> Converted) alongside actual revenue captured per campaign from Razorpay.
cases.expect: Must convert Razorpay's paise integers to INR, exclude failed/refunded payments from revenue, and should be able to flag repeat donors (see ask-14) as a funnel/retention signal.

cases.prompt: Build a fundraising board report: total raised, number of unique donors, 80G receipts issued, and top campaigns for 2025.
cases.expect: Must reconcile that not every captured payment has a matching 80G receipt (receipts are a sampled subset in this corpus) without treating the mismatch as an error, and must dedupe donors by email/contact rather than counting every payment as a new donor.

cases.prompt: Build a Budget vs Actual dashboard by expense head for Apr-Sep 2025, highlighting heads that are over budget.
cases.expect: Must use both sheets: aggregate Vouchers by Head as a cross-check against the already-pivoted 'Budget vs Actual' sheet, and flag the heads identified in ask-16.

cases.prompt: Build an ops summary dashboard for August: staff attendance (P/A/L/H) by designation, and vehicle usage (km, fuel cost) by vehicle.
cases.expect: Must derive P/A/L/H counts itself from the 31 day-columns and cross-check against the sheet's own pre-summed P/A/L/H columns; must aggregate vehicle_log.csv by vehicle and month.

cases.prompt: Build a field activity dashboard: daily children-reached trend parsed from the WhatsApp export, and visit frequency by village from the visit log, for the field coordinator.
cases.expect: Must parse the raw WhatsApp .txt export (dd/mm/yy, HH:MM - Name: message), correctly separate the one daily-count message per day from ordinary chatter/media-omitted/phone-number lines, and must not fabricate counts for days with no count message.

cases.prompt: Build a funder MIS dashboard trending households reached, SHGs formed, water structures and farmers trained from April to September 2025, by village.
cases.expect: Must reconcile the drifting column headers across the six month sheets (see ask-21) into one consistent indicator before trending, and should treat the 'Consolidated' and 'Dashboard' sheets as pre-computed checks rather than raw source data.

cases.prompt: Build a student enrolment signup form for new admissions for 2025-26, with the same fields as the Enrolment sheet.
cases.expect: Must include Aadhaar, phone and parent-detail fields with basic format validation (Aadhaar 12 digits, phone 10 digits) and must not silently overwrite an existing Student ID format like 'STU-25-0001'.

cases.prompt: Build an internal page for field staff to record a new SHG loan repayment against the monthly ledger.
cases.expect: Must look up the SHG by SHG ID or name, show current outstanding balance computed from the wide monthly columns, and record the new payment against the correct month without breaking the wide layout.

cases.prompt: Build a simple PWA for ANC visit reminders that a health worker can use offline in the field to see which women are due for their next ANC visit.
cases.expect: Must derive 'next visit due' from the ANC1-ANC4 boolean progression (not just show a static list), work offline, and handle woman/phone as sensitive data (not shown in a public view).

cases.prompt: Build a beneficiary lookup app for staff to search by UDID Number and see disability type, device issued, and issue date.
cases.expect: Must parse the UDID-shaped identifier as a string (not a number, which would drop leading structure) and must handle the mixed dd/mm/yyyy / yyyy-mm-dd date formats when displaying device_issue_date consistently.

cases.prompt: Build a donor-facing thank-you/receipt-request page after a Razorpay payment, letting the donor request an 80G receipt.
cases.expect: Must convert the paise amount to INR for display, and must not expose other donors' payment or contact data.

cases.prompt: Build an expense voucher submission form for field staff, matching the Vouchers sheet's fields (Head, Sub-head, Amount, Paid To, Mode, Project Code, Approved By).
cases.expect: Must constrain Head/Sub-head to the existing head-to-subhead mapping seen in the data (e.g. 'Programme' only pairs with its own sub-heads) rather than a free-text field.

cases.prompt: Build an offline-capable PWA for field staff to log a village visit (village, purpose, households met, issues raised) from their phone.
cases.expect: Must work with intermittent connectivity (queue-and-sync, since this team also reports over WhatsApp when signal is weak), and the issues-raised field should match the existing category set (Water shortage, Road damage, Ration delay, School infra, None).

cases.prompt: Build a public-facing MIS summary page for donors/board showing programme reach by village, safe to share outside the organisation.
cases.expect: Must use only aggregated/consolidated figures (no village-level PII exists in this file, but the page should still avoid exposing internal remarks like 'Target revised' or 'Data pending' verbatim to an external audience without context).
